posts.text:
Verstappen takes Singapore GP pole by 0.054s from Leclerc. Hamilton and Antonelli share row two. Russell's engine penalty puts him on the back row with Hadjar.

Full provisional grid: https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions

No penalty for Norris or Piastri after their final-lap Singapore sprint collision. Stella calls the contact unacceptable and will speak to both privately.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions

More power trouble for Hadjar in Singapore: his engine switched off in Q1, and he failed to set a qualifying time. He also reported a gearbox failure and wants a fresh power unit for Sunday; no change is confirmed.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions
